summary: Sky Quarry filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing receipt of a Nevada Division of Environmental Protection air permit and the restart of its Eagle Springs Refinery near Ely, Nevada, operated by subsidiary Foreland Refining Corporation. The company completed roughly $300,000 of repairs and upgrades following a 2025 TAR360 assessment; nameplate capacity is about 5,000 barrels of crude per day, with roughly 15,000 barrels of inventory on hand. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or transaction terms were disclosed; this is an operational and regulatory milestone, not a special situation. Watch ramp-up execution and crude supply logistics.
